Package com.sca4d.auth.engine

Class RedisAuthenticationAttempts

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.auth.engine.RedisAuthenticationAttempts
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.sca4d.core.api.authentication.AuthenticationAttempts
public final class RedisAuthenticationAttempts extends Object implements com.sca4d.core.api.authentication.AuthenticationAttempts
使用认证方法目录、Redis 尝试和应用动作策略编排零到三因素认证。
